projects.title: Organization and Date Extraction from Public Text

bullets.text: As an individual contribution to a supervised team project, wrote Python functions to parse provided news summary records and tested transformations on hand-checked input examples using unittest.

Under supervision, compared rule-based extraction using Python re with pretrained spaCy extraction on held-out annotated excerpts; checked span precision and recall and analyzed errors by entity type.
Under supervision, validated pandas merges with duplicate-key and unmatched-record checks, and used Matplotlib to visualize how group comparisons changed under alternative cleaning rules.
